title.zh: 银河空间中的蒂亚尼基

label.zh: 同一违规通知的三个触发
label.en: Three triggers of the same breach notice

note.zh: 106：蒂亚尼基舰队进入国境（舰队事件 galcom.102）；104：决议“蒂亚尼基害虫防治”刚通过时已有蒂亚尼基在境内（galcom.103）；109：每月检查（galcom.108）发现。三者都设置 resolution_breached_tiyanki_inside_borders。
note.en: 106: a Tiyanki fleet enters borders (fleet event galcom.102); 104: when the resolution "Tiyanki Pest Control" passes with Tiyanki already inside (galcom.103); 109: found by the monthly check (galcom.108). All set resolution_breached_tiyanki_inside_borders.

scope.zh: 蒂亚尼基入境通知：舰队进入、决议通过、每月检查三种触发。
scope.en: Tiyanki inside borders notices: fleet entry, resolution enacted and monthly check.
